title: Normalized coefficient-sheaf isomorphism for open base change
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $V\subseteq Y$, let $j:X\times_k V\to X\times_k Y$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] whose image is $\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V$, and whose composites with the projections are $\operatorname{pr}_1$ and $\operatorname{pr}_2\circ V.\iota$, respectively. There is an isomorphism of module sheaves from the restriction along $j$ of the external coefficient [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] to the external coefficient for $F$ and $G|_V$. On the restriction of the explicit tensor section $L_V(s)\otimes R_V(t)$ of [lem-sc-external-sections-components], its global-section map gives the tensor of the new projection-pullback global sections of $s$ and the restriction of $t$. Here $s\in\Gamma(X,F)$ and $t\in\Gamma(V,G)$ are arbitrary; the restriction of $t$ is transported along $V.\iota(\top)=V$. This is an isomorphism of coefficient sheaves, before restriction of scalars to $k$ or passage to tensor products of section modules, and includes the empty open.

proof.text: Apply the proved restriction-tensor comparison to the two projection pullbacks. Its inverse pure-section formula gives the forward pure-section formula by applying the hom and the inverse-hom identity, and by naturality of tensor sections under the image-equality transport.

Use the normalized open-triangle comparison for the first projection and hfst, and the normalized open-square comparison for the second projection, hj and hsnd. Tensor the resulting two isomorphisms and compose with the restriction-tensor comparison. This explicitly constructs the coefficient isomorphism.

The triangle unit equation gives the new first-projection section after composing the old restriction map with transport along hj. The square unit equation gives the new second-projection section of the transported local section. The pure-section tensorHom formula combines these equations. All restriction and adjunction comparisons include the empty open.

theorem exists_externalOpenCoefficient_normalized
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (V : Y.Opens)
    (j : Limits.pullback f (V.ι ≫ g) ⟶ Limits.pullback f g) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hj : j ''ᵁ ⊤ = pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (hfst : j ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ g))
    (hsnd : j ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ g) ≫ V.ι) :
    ∃ κ : (externalCupCoefficients f g F G).restrict j ≅
        externalCupCoefficients f (V.ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict V.ι),
      ∀ (s : Γ(F, ⊤)) (t : Γ(G, V)),
        κ.hom.app ⊤
          ((externalCupCoefficients f g F G).presheaf.map (eqToHom hj).op
            (tmulSection (M := (tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
              (N := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G)
              (((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (by simp : pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
                (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                  (pullback.fst f g))).unit.app F).app ⊤ s))
              (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app G).app V t))) =
          tmulSection (M := (tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ g))).obj F)
            (N := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ g))).obj (G.restrict V.ι))
            (tensorPullbackTopSection (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ g)) F s)
            (tensorPullbackTopSection (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ g)) (G.restrict V.ι)
              (G.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp : V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤ = V)).op t))
